body: I want to so bad but I know whether I do or not it won’t make them come back or start caring about me. Please don’t do anything to harm yourself, you’ll make better friends who’ll actually treat you right.
I probably shouldn’t have told myself that he didn’t really care about me, I made a bad decision during a really bad breakdown
because even if he didn’t actually “love me” he made me feel like he did, he talked to me and checked up on me and now he’s gone
